[Design] What one undisputed wrong REP price yields: chained reports take all of a healthy provider's REP in an hour, a provider frees locked REP, and the closing quote of the Collateral Repair Auction sets how much inventory each lot receives

[Design] Reports up to 1.1% (plus gas over report size) away from the fair price are never worth disputing, and a keeper that always reports at that edge takes all REP of positions the fair price leaves healthy
[Low] Remaining gap after #1307: commitment growth authorised by a different, larger report still voids an exact-minimum pending report and its operation batch
[Low] A rival report with the same price timestamp that settles first makes the feed reject another sponsor's report and its operation batch for good

[Low] With a one-unit lot (`minimumCommitmentAttoEth = 1`) the Collateral Repair Auction's REP grid becomes its price floor: every lot receives at least `repGrid` attoREP per raw collateral unit, 19 times the REP that backs it in the test

[Medium] `rewardVestingSeconds` accepts values that no fee stream can use; with a zero purchase fee the portfolio trades normally, but any stake on the outcome with the lowest balance reverts, so a false report cannot be disputed
